segments.text: One evening a hound came home alone, and a young woman's life turned on it.
Her name was Margaret, a farmer's daughter from Laviano, in Umbria, born in 1247.
Her mother died when she was seven. Her father remarried, and at home she found little warmth.
At seventeen she ran away with a young nobleman. Not as his wife, but as his mistress.
For nine years she lived in his castle, and she bore him a son.
Then one day he did not come home. His hound returned without him, and led her into the forest.
There, among the trees, she found him. He had been murdered.
Saint Margaret of Cortona, pray for us.

Where does a soul go
when the ground falls away?
